description: List a notebook's Studio artifacts (audio, video, report, slide_deck, mind_map, quiz, flashcards, infographic, data_table) with kind and status (pending while queued or generating, then ready or failed). Pass artifact to read one with its interactive content (HTML or mind-map tree) when Google has any.

artifact.description: one artifact id or title; returns it with its interactive content when available

kind.description: filter by kind: audio, video, report, slide_deck, mind_map, quiz, flashcards, infographic, data_table (interactive and unknown for unrecognized rows)

notebook.description: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

status.description: filter by status: pending (queued or generating), ready or failed

name: studio_list
